message.content:
An editorial magazine cover features "TEMPO" in large gray letters across the top. Below, smaller text reads "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". The main headline states "KORUPSI BTS MEMANCAR SAMPAI JAUH". A paragraph underneath mentions names like "Dito Ariotedjo" and "H.70". Smaller headlines at the very top include "Ruang Gelap RUU Omnibus Kesehatan H.26" and "Beban Pertamina di Blok Masela H.80".

The background is a purple landscape with dark silhouettes of clouds. On the right, a tall, black latticework tower stands with two small glowing lights on top. Radiating from the tower's peak are concentric, glowing teal outlines of human profiles in silhouette. These outlines expand outward like waves. The outermost teal line extends downward to a line of four black silhouetted figures on the ground. These figures are shown in profile, gripping the glowing teal line and pulling it back as if playing tug-of-war. The bottom bar contains "26 JUNI-2 JULI 2023", "RP 50.000", and a barcode with a QR code.
